name: xTool F1
tagline: Original compact fiber + diode : metal marking in a portable box
tldr: The F1 started the compact dual-laser category. Slower than F1 Ultra but often cheaper on sale. Still a metal-marking specialist with small bed : not a general workshop laser.
mainObjective: Compact metal marking plus light diode engraving for small items

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: 10W on xTool F1: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Software listed on the profile : test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers xTool F1. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Use rotary for rings. F1 Ultra is worth the upgrade if you run production metal batches.
primaryUse: Entry compact dual-laser for metal personalization and small organic-material engraving.

moduleSystem.headline: Compact dual-source engraver
moduleSystem.description: F1 combines 10W fiber marking with 10W diode engraving. Different product class from modular S1 heads.

editorialDepth.advantages: xTool F1 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
